_: THE ASSET TABLE — every image, video and audio file in both repos. Scanned fields are rewritten by `node tools/asset-table.mjs --scan`; the five judged fields (what · quality · qualityNote · verdict · revealArc) are hand-written and a scan never touches them.
_purpose: Nothing ships without Mike's personal inspection — and Mike must not have to perfect assets in advance. Slots move, things change, some of these are never needed. This table exists so an inspection can be generated on demand for whatever is actually about to ship, instead of demanding a verdict on everything up front.
_quality: Ops' honest read of the FILE, never of the idea: usable | weak | wrong | placeholder | null. `null` means NOBODY HAS LOOKED, and it is not a passing grade. `wrong` means the file does not show what its slot says it shows.
_verdict: MIKE'S, and unset by default. null = not inspected. Values are his to choose; `pass` and `reject` are what the checklist reads. Ops never writes this field.
_gate: THE RECORD APPROVAL GATE (Mike, 2026-08-04): final sign-off on a Record is Mike personally inspecting EVERY thing presented in it. `--checklist` is how that inspection is produced; a Record with any presented asset at verdict null has not been signed off.

entries.what: The MGK-VIII album cover — a close frame of the lit grille with the LED bar behind it.
entries.qualityNote: A soft hand-held snapshot with a MAINS ADAPTER, a wooden floor and loose cabling in frame, and it is the only colour original among the three covers (the wing's greyscale law hides that at the glass and cannot touch the composition). AND IT CANNOT BE STRAIGHTENED BY ROTATION: the machine's own rectangular aperture measures -1.75 deg on its top edge and +2.48 deg on its bottom, 0.13 deg off plumb on the left and 1.52 deg on the right. That is keystone, not tilt. Sampling the grille bars at four heights gives -2.69, +5.40, +3.58 and +0.12 deg for the same bars. It needs a photograph, not an edit.

entries.what: The MGK-VIII album cover — the house ROBOTS template with the machine's own head, lens forward, set into the disc the WB mark used to occupy, and the model number where the word ROBOTS was.
entries.qualityNote: THE FURNITURE IS EXACT AND THE PICTURE IS A DETAIL, and only the second is a compromise. Every constant is lifted from tools/make_robots_cover.py, so the ground, the border, the setting, the rule and the strapline are the front desk's own to the pixel. The badge is head_lens.jpg because THIS MUSEUM HOLDS NO PHOTOGRAPH OF THE MGK-VIII WHOLE — its archive is titled DETAILS ONLY and its own tombstone says the frame is withheld — so where the VIIIp cover shows a machine, this one shows a machine's face. It is the strongest reading in the set at disc size and it is still not what Mike's instruction asked for. The source is a soft hand-held frame; at 1200px the disc is upscaled from a 466px square and the grain shows on close inspection, though not at deck size. Register P4 is the photograph that would close this.

entries.what: The MGK-VIIIp album cover — the house ROBOTS template with the whole unit in the disc and the model number below it.
entries.qualityNote: This is the instruction met exactly: front_full.png is the unit, square on, whole, sharp, and the disc crop takes it without cutting the machine. The faceplate and the lit glass are legible inside the badge at full size, which is a bonus rather than the point — at deck size it reads as an object. Two departures from the base cover, both deliberate and both applied to BOTH machine covers so the pair cannot drift: the rule sits 14px lower so this name's descender clears it, and the letter-tracking is solved per cover so nine glyphs set inside the measure six do. The word still runs wider than the rule beneath it, which the six-glyph cover does not — the one place the pair is visibly unequal.

_revealArc: THE REVEAL ARC (Mike, 2026-08-04): arrived | understood | partial | online | null. The house's canon for how a thing is revealed — acknowledged when it arrived, status-updated as it was understood, brought online in stages — applied to every asset so a visitor can be given the sequence the house actually lived, test patterns and noise included. `null` means UNSET and is not a stage: it is the honest state of an asset whose arc nobody has established. Ops populates only what the record already attests.
